purpose: Validate the P5C OPEN semantic-first runtime after replacing raw snapshot-marker-only semantic success verification with a fresh post-action Computer Control ui.describe observation of the re-resolved target, while preserving independent verification and delivery != success.
requiredClaims: OPEN remains semantic-first and semantic success prevents P5A, visual perception, the visual provider and the visual post-action observer from running.
After semantic delivery, Computer Use acquires a fresh post-action snapshot and re-resolves the deterministic semantic target before verification.
The semantic postcondition may be satisfied by Computer Control ui.describe only when the fresh target description reports selected=true; focus or delivery alone never proves success.

The AppKit radio fixture physically exposes checked=true and selected=true through the normalized Computer Control description after activation even though the compact textual snapshot does not expose a checked/selected marker.
The physical test independently re-resolves and describes the semantic target outside the executor before accepting the semantic branch success oracle.
The visual target RUMIAI CLICK 517 remains absent from the semantic fixture accessibility representation and therefore yields structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Only the P5B-eligible structured semantic observability gap can reach the explicit P5C visual fallback handoff.
The visual branch reuses the already validated P4/P5A delivery path with an injected local macOS Vision PoC provider; provider selection remains outside P5C.
CLICK_POSTED proves delivery only and is never task success.
Visual OPEN succeeds only from a fresh independent post-action visual observation satisfying the exact RUMIAI DONE 864 postcondition and yielding VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
Planner output remains semantic and contains no provider, visual target query, postcondition or screen coordinates.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload text and action coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted in session evidence.
Computer Use and Computer Control working trees remain clean after the session.
nonClaims: P5C does not wire provider selection or visual fallback configuration into the normal agent loop; that remains P5E after P5D.
P5C does not define concrete perception-provider discovery or selection; that remains P5D.
The AppKit radio fixture is test infrastructure only and creates no application-specific product dependency.
P5C does not make semantic action-delivery failure or semantic postcondition-verification failure visually eligible.
P5C does not treat focused=true as semantic success.
P5C does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy matching, VLM/object/icon targeting or arbitrary coordinate planning.
The P1-P4 physical sessions and P5A/P5B evidence remain immutable and are not rerun or rewritten.
P5C s01 evidence commit 15976727c6b6a09b09b428c415c5daf74e6c0258 remains immutable as the unregistered custom-fixture failure.
P5C s02 evidence commit 86793f0077d0926554c71422e4394b3bf3c62b9a remains immutable as the registered but unsnapshotable direct-executable fixture failure.
P5C s03 evidence commit 26be209cfcdb9fa5ab81a2a23d823344c598a6d8 remains immutable as the LaunchServices custom-fixture snapshot failure.
P5C s04 evidence commit 630ac6c68cc7c960c01455a85dadbfb9f51abca8 remains immutable as the System Settings no-AX-window surface mismatch.
P5C s05 evidence commit 4c20c9bc2425829a26207f46a7c99fab54be1a9d remains immutable as the first snapshotable AppKit fixture run that reached OPEN verification and failed the title-based oracle.
P5C s06 evidence commit 9b695a32383ae22b70dd1498d823ebb27ae0080b remains immutable: the radio action was delivered but OPEN still failed because the compact snapshot did not expose selected state.

P5C s07 evidence commit f2a2b81263f1ba052745e1dc9ef021a7533f1231 remains immutable: the snapshot parser normalization contract passed, but the physical run proved the compact snapshot still omitted checked/selected and therefore the runtime needed normalized ui.describe verification.

diagnosis.conclusion: Semantic action delivery was successful. The failed oracle was caused by reading semantic selection only from compact snapshot markers instead of the normalized Computer Control control description.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s08 unchanged and diagnose only from its exact result; never rewrite prior evidence.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned semantic and visual fixture content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted or logged by session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P5D concrete perception-provider delivery and selection boundary
